prompt: Add src/config.js exporting loadConfig({ cwd = process.cwd(), env = process.env } = {}). It reads .env and then .env.local from cwd (either may be missing) and returns a plain object of strings, without changing process.env. The result has every key found in .env and .env.local, and nothing else; for each of those keys env wins over .env.local, which wins over .env. Values follow the usual .env rules: a double-quoted value may span several lines and expands \n escapes, a single-quoted value is taken literally, and an unquoted value ends at ' #' (an inline comment). Use the dotenv package that is already installed; do not add, upgrade, or replace dependencies. Add tests.
